findings.message: page "": traits 'StkOne' and 'StkTwo' both render into slot 'main' from inside a ticks block, and no tick guard switches either one off — a ticks block runs EVERY frame, so they paint slot 'main' on every frame and the runtime stacks them into one growing column instead of showing either
findings.suggestion: Give exactly one trait slot 'main': set config { running: false } on the others at this call site, or send them to different slots by making the slot a config knob on the atom (write (render-ui @config.surface ...) in the atom's .lolo, declare `surface` in its config, then set a different value per trait here)
